tools.name: list_games
tools.description: List the competitions a Grey Tabby Golf group can run from one weekly round.

tools.name: get_game_details
tools.description: Explain one Grey Tabby Golf competition and how it is scored. Pass a name returned by list_games.

tools.name: list_features
tools.description: Describe what a Grey Tabby Golf organizer and player can do. Event Director is not included with every subscription.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Return Grey Tabby Golf pricing: $9.99 per month, the 30-day trial, and the cancellation terms.

tools.name: get_product_demo
tools.description: Return the organizer and player demonstration links for Grey Tabby Golf.

tools.name: play_commercial
tools.description: Return the official Grey Tabby Golf commercial video URL, captions, duration, and transcript.

tools.name: start_trial
tools.description: Return the existing secure Grey Tabby Golf 30-day trial signup URL. This does not create an account or start billing.
